correctness.rationale: C PASS. Under independently resampled Bernoulli coefficient rows (G1), conditional on entire fair ξ, row parities ζ_n are independent and have exact means b_n=(1−2p)^(2^{M_n}). Symmetric Bernoulli negative-count M_n visits each k with geometric mean two, giving E∑_(n>=1)|b_n| = r+2∑_(k>=1)r^(2^k), r=|1−2p|<1, and square-summability. Conditional product density martingale is L²-bounded, with log-density converging to a finite real value almost surely, hence annealed P_p and independent-reference Q are mutually absolutely continuous on FULL infinite path space. Coordinatewise total-variation bounds give minimum cost ∑|b_n|/2 and are attained simultaneously by independent shared-uniform maximal couplings, giving B(p)=r/2+∑_(k>=1)r^(2^k), finite edits a.s. Binomial occupation sums prove optimal expected mismatch tail 2^(−N+o(N)); dyadic exponential series proves endpoint logarithm. Each deterministic environment maps ξ to η and yields a graph Q-null, establishing quenched singularity; p=1/2 equality and p=0,1 singularity follow. Independent exact finite binomial and parity checks supplement the infinite-measure argument.

originality.rationale: O PASS best knowledge. Hamza–Tournier 2026 fully inspected primary paper defines exactly the (G1) row-independence model and proves quenched/annealed functional CLTs and related binomial estimates; these are acknowledged. Convergence of diffusive rescalings neither implies nor precludes equivalence of complete unscaled infinite path laws or optimal finite Hamming edits. Product-measure equivalence criteria and maximal coupling are standard, whereas the exact model-specific occupation/cost formula and phase boundary were not found as prior results in examined source. Equivalents in finitary isomorphism/measure comparison literature remain a priority risk.
residual_risks: The proof is restricted to independent-within/across-row Bernoulli (G1) constant p and a coupling preserving ξ; not dependent (G) or n-invariant (G2).
Standard product-measure/finitary isomorphism literature might contain an equivalent direct corollary.
The mismatch tail is optimal expected number of tail discrepancies, not unconditional total-variation mixing.
